details.current_behavior: Local functions (void Helper() { ... }) defined inside kernel methods cannot be expanded to C++ and cause build errors.

details.current_behavior: Currently limited to simple replacements to C++ templates; complex type constraints and overload resolution are limited.

details.strategy: Implemented BclIntrinsicMapBuilder to dynamically parse BclIntrinsicMapAttribute and map standard BCL methods to target dialect intrinsics.
details.target_cuda: Intercepts C# .NET static calls and substitutes them with [CudaIntrinsic] equivalents.

title: AST expansion of C# string interpolation ($) in Gpu.InlinePtx

details.current_behavior: Recursively traverses InterpolatedStringExpressionSyntax, outputting plain text parts as-is and falling back to C++ AST expansion for interpolated parts ({x + 1}).
details.strategy: Hybrid expansion to safely embed C# variables into PTX inline assembly.
details.csharp_example: Gpu.InlinePtx("asm volatile ("nop;");");

title: PTX macro expansion of compile-time constants using Gpu.JitConstant("Name")

details.current_behavior: Replaces Gpu.JitConstant calls with a simple identifier name (Name) defined via #define on the PTX side and outputs it.
details.strategy: Static expansion combined with __gsharp_jit_constants in JitEngine.
details.csharp_example: Gpu.InlinePtx("asm volatile ("nop;");");

title: GSH0007: foreach is prohibited because it implicitly allocates IEnumerator, putting pressure on the GPU heap.

details.strategy: Implemented Roslyn Analyzer GSH0007 to explicitly prohibit foreach loops to prevent hidden IEnumerator heap allocations.

title: GSH0009: Prohibition of combining var with numeric literals without suffixes

details.current_behavior: Statements like var x = 10; trigger an error to prevent incorrect 32-bit signed integer inference by auto in C++ (forcing 10U, etc.).
details.strategy: Guarantees the safety of type inference.

title: GSH0012/0006: Compile-time constant and string literal constraints for Gpu macro arguments

details.current_behavior: The argument for Gpu.ForUnroll must be a constant, and the argument for Gpu.InlinePtx must be a string literal/interpolation.
details.strategy: Only allows values that can be determined during the AST evaluation phase.

title: Two-stage JIT cache and NVRTC runtime compilation architecture

details.current_behavior: JitEngine performs a two-stage cache based on source hashes: a ConcurrentDictionary in memory and PTX files on disk.
details.strategy: Implemented Two-stage JIT caching (ThreadStatic cache and ConcurrentDictionary with Lazy<Delegate>) to eliminate zero-allocation overhead during engine dispatch.

title: Thread-safe exclusive control via Lazy<T> and CudaContextScope (RAII)

details.current_behavior: Uses Lazy<GpuModule> for exclusive control during initial compilation, and further binds/automatically restores the CUDA context per thread using CudaContextScope (IDisposable).
details.strategy: Introduced Lazy<T> in JIT engine and Context initialization to ensure thread-safe exclusive control under concurrent workloads.

details.current_behavior: Operators (+, -, *, /) for GpuBigInteger instances are generated as expression tree objects (GpuBigIntExpr), and the actual GPU kernels are issued upon calling .Value or .Evaluate().
details.strategy: Implemented expression tree fusion and mathematical operator overloading on GpuBigInteger struct to optimize memory bandwidth.

details.strategy: Implemented [CudaIntrinsic] and [BclIntrinsicMap] attributes for transparent AST mapping and C++ proxy generation.
